meta.title: Cluster Migration: Export, Translate, Recreate, Prove It Autoscales

views.label: Translate, don't copy
views.note: Node types, instance profiles, and storage credentials all differ by name across clouds — map by workload profile, not name.

views.label: Policies before pools
views.note: Cost and compliance guardrails land in the policy before pools are recreated on top of it.

views.label: Legacy access modes don't carry over
views.note: Unity Catalog requires shared or single-user access — legacy shared-no-isolation and high-concurrency clusters must convert.

cards.title: Map by profile, not by name
items: Node type names don't correspond 1:1 across Azure, AWS, and GCP
Match on workload profile instead: CPU, memory, GPU, local SSD
Instance profiles, managed identities, and service accounts all need target-cloud principals

cards.title: Access modes are the migration's UC gate
items: Unity Catalog requires shared or single-user access modes
Legacy shared-no-isolation and high-concurrency clusters don't carry over — they convert
Get this wrong and the cluster attaches to nothing in the target metastore

cards.title: Prove it before calling it done
items: Policies carry cost and compliance guardrails — recreate them before pools, not after
Pools need target-cloud idle-termination tuning, not a copied source value
A smoke test validates autoscaling actually behaves the same, not just that the cluster starts
